verdict.rationale: Wrike documents a public read/write REST API with OAuth 2.0, a Batch API, webhooks, and endpoints for attachments, versions and task approvals, plus an MCP connection for managing tasks and workflows. None of this establishes parity with the UI: there is no explicit parity claim, many UI features (whiteboards, dashboards, Kanban/table views, budgeting, AI agents) have no evidenced API coverage, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, evidenced API coverage of UI features like whiteboards, dashboards, budgets and agents, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
